requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-5075--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4247-4871.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

277-1308-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

647-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
647-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
647-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

338-4268-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4268-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-2034-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2034-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

1018-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skullwinder and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Skullwinder and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

5657-5664-5910.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}. Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability trigger.
Holding priority, cast Nameless Inversion by paying {1}{B}
Ulalek triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

141-780-5256.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

678-2292-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-2292-6749.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

3457-3784-6657.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Seeker of Skybreak ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2843-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2438-2843-6553.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2047-2707-4872-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2047-2707-4872-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Warp onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-967-5258-5618-6131.description:
Cast Ignot Chewer for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Ingot Chewer enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, destroying target artifact.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to sacrifice Ingot Chewer.
When Ingot Chewer dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Ingot Chewer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger from step 7, causing you to exile the top five cards of your library, including Ingot Chewer, with the ability to play those cards until end of turn.
Cast Ingot Chewer from exile for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Prosper and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Prosper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 3.

586-2511-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3168-4452-4770-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Rukarumel.
3168-4452-4770-5613.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-3263-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
215-3263-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
215-3263-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {2}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

2363-4316-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Hangarback Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

396-2034-4365-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

512-3990-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Halo Fountain and Incubation Druid do not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
512-3990-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping it and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-2156-2495-4074.description:
Activate Chandra, Hope's Beacon's second ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Chandra, Bold Pyromancer's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R} and dealing 2 damage to a player.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Tezzeret's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

1411-3903.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling the spell and allowing them to cast another nonland card exiled by Knowledge Pool without paying its mana cost.
Because Soulless Jailer prevents noncreature spells from being cast from exile, no player may cast noncreature spells as permitted by Knowledge Pool.

1017-1242-1656-4041.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1242-1656-4041.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Merfolk Looter's ability by tapping it, causing you to loot.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using CInderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1292-1976-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

804-2724-3987.description:
Cast Sakashima for {2}{U}{U}, entering as a copy of Wormfang Manta.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.

1987-3075-3277-3941.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3277-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
